meta.name: ahrq-reason-classification
meta.description: Classify gap root causes using AHRQ 4-reason framework (insufficient info, biased info, inconsistent info, not yet integrated).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需用AHRQ框架系统分析差距根因
copy.tagline_en: Classify gap root causes using AHRQ framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically classify gap root causes using the AHRQ framework

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会用AHRQ四原因框架（信息不足、信息偏差、信息不一致、尚未整合）对研究差距的根本原因进行分类。
howto.when: 当你提供研究差距描述和相关证据时，Claude会触发该技能进行分析。

say.text: 用AHRQ框架分析这个研究差距的原因。
say.note: Claude会基于提供的描述和证据进行分类。

say.text: 分类以下差距：信息不足还是偏差？
say.note: 你会得到具体的根本原因类型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude classifies the root cause of research gaps using the AHRQ 4-reason framework (insufficient info, biased info, inconsistent info, not yet integrated).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a gap description and surrounding evidence.

say_en.text: Classify this research gap using AHRQ framework.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze based on provided description and evidence.

say_en.text: Is this gap due to insufficient or biased information?
say_en.note: You will get the specific root cause type.
